key.name: hud-shortcut
key.description: Opens the HUD from any app.

key.name: take-input-source-key
key.summary: Use Super+Space even with two or more keyboard layouts
key.description: Set only in Preferences. When true, HeadsUp takes Super+Space from GNOME's keyboard layout switch (Shift+Super+Space still switches layouts).

key.name: close-on-click-outside
key.summary: Close the HUD on a click elsewhere

key.name: hud-shortcut-status
key.summary: Whether the wake shortcut works, written after each try

key.name: hud-shortcut-active
key.summary: The wake shortcut's keys while they are registered; empty otherwise
key.description: Written only by the shell, just before it registers the keys the table accepted.

key.name: hud-shortcut-holder
key.summary: The GNOME action that holds the wake shortcut, for the in-use status

key.name: input-source-claim
key.summary: Whether HeadsUp took the wake shortcut from layout switching

key.name: input-source-binding
key.summary: Layout switching keys: the value before HeadsUp took the shortcut, and the value it wrote

key.name: layout-notice
key.summary: Show the one-time notice that a second layout took the shortcut back
